comments.body: Question: this page says the Memorial Album reward Ruqun has +2 Collection and +1 Perfume Trade, but the MA page shows +1 Swordplay and +1 Caution. Which one do you actually get for completing the MA entry?

comments.body:

comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
You should read information from top to bottom. It means that Ruqun with +2 Collection and +1 Perfume Trading you can get from shipwreck.
From memorial album you get Ruqun with +1 Swordplay and +1 Caution
